First, Money → a settlement rail the parties name in the offer: the FLOP has-station escrow, an x402 flow, an EVM/NEAR/BTC HTLC contract, or anything else that can hold funds under the same hash or point statement. Second, Nobody accepts a cloud provider verifying its own compute — neutrality is the product, and incumbents structurally cannot offer it. Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flop-labs/tclk/main/SPEC.md ; https://flop.finance/teaser/
